domain: Adjudication of the reuse-before-regenerate match mechanism — direct re-verification of a live round-0/round-1 disagreement (fd-recsys-reuse-relevance's f-009 vs fd-knowledge-graph-edge-schema's f-025) against current repo line numbers and the sibling implementation plan, rather than resting on the prior findings' quoted evidence alone
axioms: A disputed claim is adjudicated against the live artifact, not against the prior findings' quoted evidence — line numbers and function bodies can move or already be superseded between rounds.
Refuting a finding's literal mechanism does not close its underlying risk; the risk survives independently and must be re-tested on its own terms.
A brainstorm naming one integration point ('the existing seam') is a falsifiable claim about that seam's actual code, not a description that can be taken on faith once ratified.

When two documents claim to describe the same mechanism (a ratified brief and its downstream implementation plan), the more recent, more concrete one wins unless proven otherwise — but the older one is what readers who stop at the brief will actually believe.
primitives: position 1 / position 2 (the two disputing findings' claims, held apart and each independently re-tested rather than merged)
the named seam (the exact tool or function a design doc claims performs a mechanism, verified by reading its handler)
the sibling document (an implementation plan dated the same day as the brainstorm it is meant to realize, checked for whether it agrees with the ratified text)
live re-verification (reading current line numbers and function bodies directly, not trusting a prior round's citations to still be accurate)
failure_mode: Only adjudicates the specific disagreement it was dispatched at — it does not go looking for other disagreements or unrelated risk in the same document.

Can mistake 'the plan already fixes this' for 'the risk is closed' when the brainstorm remains the artifact readers actually consult — a mitigation that lives in a second document is not a mitigation to the document under review.

Depends on the sibling plan being real, current, and actually wired into the tools it claims to gate (seed.md/melange-workflow.js call sites) — does not independently verify that the plan itself has shipped or been executed.
